description: Project Tricorder — Clinical Infrastructure for Field Operations We're looking for a hands-on engineer to build two foundations of the Tricorder product: the evaluation harness and training data pipeline behind our AI models, and a clinical knowledge base grounded in tactical combat care, SNOMED CT and ICD-10. About Project Tricorder - https://www.tricorder-systems.com/ Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity and a clinician at a desk. Care increasingly happens somewhere else - in the field, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient reaches a ward. Tricorder builds the deployable clinical infrastructure for that world: a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform that lets clinical teams capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when the network or the grid can't be relied on. It is a dual-use venture serving defence medical and civilian pre-hospital care. Our prototype product is already in user testing. Edge AI sits at the core: multimodal language models that turn video, sensor data and clinical notes into patient records, drive predictions and inform data-driven learnings across deployments. To trust those models in the field, we need rigorous data and evaluation - that's where you come in. What you'll do You'll own two workstreams, working day to day with the founder and the FF build team. 1. Data pipeline and evaluation harness Build the data foundations that tell us whether our models are good enough for clinical use. Data labelling: design labelling schemas and guidelines, set up tooling, and run labelling with clinical input, including quality checks and inter-annotator agreement. Data processing: build reproducible pipelines to ingest, clean, de-identify and transform multimodal data (video, sensor streams, text). Video data organisation: structure, version and catalogue video datasets so clips, annotations and metadata stay searchable and traceable. Training dataset preparation: assemble balanced, well-documented train, validation and test splits, with clear lineage from raw data to model input. Eval harness: build an automated harness that benchmarks vision-language and NLP models against clinically meaningful metrics, tracks regressions and supports build-vs-buy model decisions. 2. Clinical knowledge base Build the structured clinical knowledge base that turns unstructured input into coded, interoperable records. Database design: design the schema and stand up the data store for clinical concepts and their relationships. Clinical terminologies: ingest and map TC3, SNOMED CT, ICD-10 and related NHS standards, including cross-mappings between them. Natural language processing: extract entities and relationships from clinical text and link them to coded concepts. Document handling: parse and structure clinical documents (PDFs, notes, forms) into the database. Clinical knowledge: work with clinicians to make sure the database reflects real-world clinical reasoning and pre-hospital workflows. By the end of the first 3 months, we'd expect a working eval harness in use for model decisions, a labelled and versioned core dataset, and a first version of the knowledge base linked to the product. What we're looking for We don't expect one person to be expert in everything below. Strong candidates will be deep in one workstream and credible in the other. Must-haves Strong Python and data engineering skills, with a track record of shipping production data or ML pipelines, not just research notebooks. Hands-on experience building ML evaluation frameworks, benchmarks or test harnesses, ideally for vision, video or language models. Experience running data labelling and training-data preparation, including annotation tooling and quality control. Working knowledge of databases and data modelling. Practical NLP experience: entity extraction, entity linking or document parsing. Comfort handling sensitive data under data protection and clinical safety constraints. Pragmatism and speed: you can work with ambiguity, make good build-vs-buy calls and ship in weeks, not quarters. Nice to have Experience with SNOMED CT, ICD-10, dm+d or other NHS clinical terminologies and coding. A background in health-tech, clinical informatics or another regulated domain such as defence. Experience with video data at scale (frame sampling, temporal annotation, multimodal datasets). Familiarity with FHIR or HL7 interoperability standards. Experience working with LLMs and VLMs, including edge or on-device deployment. Early-stage startup experience, especially as a founding or early engineer. Probably not the right fit if You need detailed specs and a large team around you to be effective. You prefer pure research over building tools people use every day. This is a high urgency opening, and we are flexible to consider applicants either on a more flexible consultancy agreement (rolling by mutual agreement, with a competitive day rate); or a long term permanent employment contract with shares as part of the package and scope to grow into a longer-term role as Tricorder builds its engineering team. title: Full Stack Engineer
description: Getting homes off fossil fuels means fitting millions of heat pumps, solar panels and batteries, and every one has to be designed, sold and fitted by an installer. The assets themselves already work brilliantly, but getting them into homes is still slow, complex and painful. Our mission is to change that: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run a renewables installation business, and get homes off fossil fuels way faster. In just a few years we've become the leading platform for heat pump installers in the UK and Ireland, with around half of all heat pump installations now being managed on Spruce. We've just launched our solar and battery product, and we're building on that to go after even bigger opportunities: every other type of job these installers do, the rest of how they run their business, and a bunch of new countries. We're now on the hunt for truly brilliant engineers to help us move faster and go further. 🌲 About Spruce Almost 20% of the UK's carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there's simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can't currently offer a heat pump when someone's boiler breaks and they urgently need heating. We're fixing this. We've built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we're having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job and doubling their sales conversion rates. We raised a chunky Seed round last year from top-tier investors and this year have doubled the team and grown revenue 4x. We've expanded into Ireland, have just launched an end-to-end solar and battery product, and are increasingly becoming the operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and AutoCAD, you might get a sense of where we're headed… 🥖 The Role You'll work closely with a small, high-calibre team of engineers, designers and domain experts to build and scale the tools that power our installer software, owning and delivering complex features end-to-end from day one. The problem space is deep and varied, including: Heat loss modelling and hydronic system design 2D and 3D floor-plan tooling using LiDAR and computer vision Large-scale data ingestion and geospatial analysis Offline-first, collaborative PWAs Hardware integrations (Bluetooth measurement tools, sensors, monitoring systems) This is not CRUD-only work. You'll be working on meaningful production problems from day one that blend physical reality, real-world constraints, and serious impact. 🥞 Tech Stack Our tech stack strives for simplicity, symmetry and efficiency. Our hard problems come from the real world instead of self-made architectural problems. You don't need to know all of the below, but you do need an appetite for full stack mastery and owning the problem end to end: Docker, Docker Compose PostgreSQL, PostGIS, Atlas migrations Node, Prisma React, TypeScript, Konva, Tailwind 🫵 About You We look for the same five things in everyone at Spruce: curiosity; intense drive, ambition and work ethic; a high degree of personal agency and ownership; deep humility and a growth mindset; and excellent craft. We're hiring at mid-level: you've probably been shipping production code for a few years. We care less about titles and more about impact, judgment, and intent. You'll likely have experience with: Modern JavaScript / TypeScript and frontend frameworks Backend development and API design Relational databases and data modelling But more importantly, you are: Product-minded – you want to understand real users and real problems, not just tickets; Impact-driven – you balance technical quality with momentum and know when "good enough" is exactly right; Comfortable with ownership – you take responsibility for outcomes, not just code; Candid and collaborative – you challenge ideas openly, receive feedback well, and optimise for the team over ego; Already using AI intensively – you use it every day to make yourself disproportionately more effective, and you can show us how. … and you'll hopefully also love heat pumps! 🤓 🌟 Our offer 💰 £50–100k salary, depending on experience 🍰 Equity (options) in the company 🏡 Hybrid working: 2 days in-person a week (London or Bristol), with full-team meetups every fortnight 🏖️ 33 days holiday (25 plus bank holidays) and opportunity to work from abroad for another 30 days each year 🏥 Private Medical Cover (Vitality) 👧 Workplace Nursery Benefit scheme ( YellowNest ) 🧑‍🍼 Enhanced Parental Leave 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Brilliant team to learn from and massive opportunity to grow 🧑‍💻 Working at Spruce We're currently a close-knit team of 35, split between London and Bristol. We spend 2–3 days each week working together in-person in both locations, and get everyone together every fortnight. You'll have genuine influence from day one. The best idea wins regardless of seniority. We expect you to challenge everything, ask "why?" multiple levels deep, and push back when something doesn't make sense. We want everyone to spend time with installers on-site, feel their pain points, then rapidly suggest and implement solutions based on real feedback rather than assumptions. We move fast and ship imperfect things, learning from users rather than trying to perfect in isolation. When things break, we focus on how we fix it and what we can learn – and never blame. You'll own your outcomes whilst knowing the team has your back. Feedback is constant, direct, and kind – we'll tell you when something isn't working and expect the same honesty (and empathy) back. title: Client Services Manager - Bridging
description: About Allica Bank Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech. Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers. Department Description The Bridging Department at Allica Bank is a high-energy, specialist lending team supporting established SMEs and professional property investors with fast, flexible short-term finance. Operating within a true challenger-bank environment, the team combines strong credit discipline with pragmatic decision-making, relationship-led lending, and a clear focus on delivering the right outcomes for customers. This is a fast-paced and constantly evolving department where no two days are the same. Deals are time-critical, varied, and often bespoke, requiring commercial thinking, sound judgement, and a willingness to take ownership from day one. As the Bridging proposition continues to grow, the role and the department evolve week by week. The team is lively, proactive, and highly collaborative. People are trusted to act like owners, take responsibility for their decisions, and work closely with colleagues across Distribution, Credit, Operations, and external partners to keep things moving. There is a strong emphasis on keeping things clear and simple, working at pace, and removing unnecessary barriers to getting good deals done. True to Allica’s values, the Bridging Department is built on teamwork, transparency, and doing the right thing for customers and the Bank. Ideas are welcomed, expertise is respected, and individuals are encouraged to challenge constructively, improve processes, and contribute to the continued success of a growing SME-focused lender. Role Description The Client Services – Team Lead is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing a team of Client Services Associates and Managers, driving high performance, accountability, and strong credit outcomes. The role plays a key part in building capability across the team, supporting individual development plans and succession planning, and fostering a culture where the team feel confident to challenge, escalate, and continuously improve. Alongside people leadership, the role holds responsibility for packaging and structuring complex bridging transactions, ensuring lending decisions align with the Bank’s Credit Policy, risk appetite, and asset strategy, while delivering fast, high quality outcomes for SME and professional property clients. The Client Services -Team Lead plays a critical role within Allica Bank’s Bridging proposition, supporting the delivery of fast, flexible lending solutions to SME and professional property clients. Client Services are responsible for working with the BDMs in increasing originations, structuring Indicative Terms and carrying out an initial assessment of borrowing requests to evaluate feasibility and alignment with the Bank’s credit appetite. Acting as the first point of “triage”, the role determines whether enquiries are suitable to progress, ensuring only well-structured, viable applications are submitted to Credit. This early intervention is fundamental to maintaining pace, quality, and conversion through the lending journey. The role works closely alongside Business Development Managers and the Credit team, supporting the effective transition of enquiries into fully packaged applications. Client Services Associates prepare high-quality files for submission, ensuring key information is captured accurately and efficiently to support timely credit decisioning. The Client Services – Team Lead may also be involved in originating, structuring, and progressing bridging applications from Introducers and Borrowers, from initial enquiry through to completion. Client Services act as a trusted point of contact for brokers, providing clarity, guidance, and responsiveness throughout the early stages of the process. The role also involves liaising with third parties such as surveyors and solicitors, coordinating activity to help drive cases smoothly towards completion. Principal Accountabilities  Provide clear day-to-day leadership to the Client Services team, setting expectations on quality, pace, and behaviours.  Own the allocation of new and existing bridging cases, ensuring fair distribution.  Actively manage the pipeline to maintain momentum on time-critical transactions and Reallocate work where necessary to avoid delays or bottlenecks  Serve as the primary escalation and guidance point for questions from the team.  Coach and develop the team through regular feedback, case reviews, and on-the-job learning.  Conduct regular case reviews, quality assurance, and feedback sessions. Generate Indicative Terms and progress loan applications within agreed service level agreements (SLAs), utilising appropriate credit data and analytical tools.  Proactively manage the application journey from initial enquiry through to completion, coordinating effectively with panel solicitors, valuers, project monitors, asset managers, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely instruction, accurate documentation, and smooth case progression.  Undertake regular checks, Customer due diligence, and monitor agreed controls to ensure the Bank’s risk and customer requirements are met at all times, escalating immediately any areas of concern.  Produce clear, accurate, and concise written documentation to support high-quality credit decisioning, making well-reasoned recommendations to the Credit team and ensuring all activity is accurately recorded and maintained within CRM systems.  Liaise effectively with applicants, intermediaries, valuers, solicitors, and other third parties to obtain additional information required to support applications and resolve issues efficiently through to completion.  Deliver a consistently high standard of service to customers, brokers, Relationship Managers, and Business Development Managers, building and maintaining strong, trusted relationships in line with the Bank’s values and defined customer experience standards  Actively support external Business Development Managers by identifying, developing, and nurturing new broker and customer opportunities, contributing to the growth of the Bridging proposition and conversion of enquiries into applications  Ensure full compliance with all mandatory policies, regulatory requirements, and credit procedures, maintaining robust internal controls and governance standards at all times Support the development and ongoing enhancement of management information (MI) and key performance indicators (KPIs), maintaining accurate and timely reporting to provide clear visibility of the mortgage and bridging processing pipeline  Proactively identify opportunities for improvement across the Bank and the Client Services team, taking ownership for delivering enhancements and setting a positive example through behaviours aligned to Allica’s values  Where applicable, complete monthly assurance and quality assurance dip-testing on cases agreed for direct reports, providing clear feedback, guidance, and development support as required. Personal Attributes & Experience  Credible leader who builds trust quickly with underwriters, brokers, and senior stakeholders.  Demonstrable experience leading, coaching, or mentoring underwriters.  Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and confidence in decision-making.  Balance speed with risk discipline, ensuring complex or higher-risk cases receive appropriate senior input  Strong experience in the Bridging sector, with an understanding of the competitive landscape, key market dynamics, and current trends in short-term property finance.  Strong analytical capability combined with clear, confident verbal and written communication skills, enabling the role holder to assess enquiries effectively and communicate decisions, rationale, and next steps clearly to brokers, customers, and internal stakeholders.  A pragmatic and confident problem-solver who consistently stands out from their peers through the ability to assess complex scenarios, apply sound commercial judgement, and clearly justify decisions in line with the Bank’s credit appetite and customer outcomes.  Highly organised with excellent time-management and prioritisation skills, able to deliver accurate, high-quality work in a fast-paced, time-critical environment while managing multiple cases simultaneously.  A relationship-led professional who builds strong, trusted, and lasting relationships with internal stakeholders including Distribution, Operations, Credit, and senior management, as well as with external partners such as intermediaries, valuers, and solicitors.  Demonstrates a strong understanding of, and commitment to, regulatory requirements, internal policies, procedures, risk controls, and service level expectations, with a disciplined and responsible approach to governance.  Good working knowledge of Treating Customers Fairly (TCF), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Know Your Customer (KYC), and Conduct Risk, with a clear focus on doing the right thing for customers and the Bank.  Confident and capable user of technology, with experience of CRM systems and strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word to support effective case management, reporting, and documentation. Working at Allica Bank At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers. Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind: Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities Options for flexible working Regular social activities Pension contributions Discretionary bonus scheme Private health cover Life assurance Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave Don’t tick every box? Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you! Flexible working We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate. Diversity We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like. title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Got Drive? Join AnyVan as we make moving anything, anywhere miles better and build a career that moves just as fast. Back in 2009, our Chairman Angus saw half-empty vans everywhere and knew there had to be a better way! That's how AnyVan began. He set out to create the world's most efficient logistics technology and help halve the number of wasted miles by filling those empty vans. Since then we've become the nation's favourite way to move, with over 150k five-star reviews and 5 million customers in the UK and Europe. Our team of 400 AnyVanners across London, Cape Town and Bogota is proving that moving doesn't have to cost the earth by helping save 8,520 tonnes of Carbon each year. Build systems that move the real world, with AI at the core At AnyVan, we're building one of the most sophisticated logistics optimisation platforms in Europe. We connect customer demand with real-time driver availability, using intelligent matching, dynamic pricing, and AI to deliver a world-class service at market-beating prices. By routing jobs to vans already on the road, we reduce wasted miles, cut emissions, and ensure drivers earn fairly. It's logistics, pricing, and marketplace dynamics, driven by software and increasingly by machine intelligence. We're hiring for two Senior Engineer roles. Both sit in the same engineering team, share the same stack and ways of working, and put AI at the heart of what they build. The difference is the problem you'll focus on: one role is all about the AI agents behind our Sales and Customer Service teams, the other is about Allocations, getting our transport partners matched to the right jobs. Let us know in your application which one interests you most. Role 1: Senior Engineer, AI Agents (Sales & Customer Service) In this role, you'll help build and scale the AI agents behind our Sales and Customer Service teams. These agents handle real conversations with real customers every day, answering questions, qualifying leads, quoting moves and resolving issues across phone, chat and messaging. You'll own them end to end, from designing how they reason and which tools and data they can use, to the evaluation, guardrails and observability that keep them accurate, on-brand and safe in production. You'll work closely with our Sales and CS leaders and the agents who use these tools on the front line, so you can see the impact of your work in conversion, response times and customer satisfaction. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to move LLM-powered systems past the demo stage and into something thousands of customers rely on. Role 2: Senior Engineer, Allocations In this role, you'll work with our Allocations team on the data and back-end engineering problems behind how our transport partners access jobs, get booked and are allocated against the right work. You'll focus on the data, platforms and tools that make that happen. This is the engine behind routing jobs to vans already on the road, so you'll see the impact of your work directly in how efficiently jobs are matched and how fairly drivers earn. We move fast: We're embedding AI and machine learning across our core platform, not as experiments, but as production systems that drive real business outcomes: Real-time, intelligent pricing that models true job-level costs and responds dynamically to supply, demand, and market conditions Predictive demand and routing models that forecast driver availability and optimise job allocation before a customer even books LLM-powered tooling across our internal and customer-facing products, from intelligent quoting to driver workflow automation A two-sided marketplace where drivers can buy and sell jobs to maximise utilisation — powered by smart matching algorithms This is genuinely leading-edge work: production AI systems, at scale, on problems that matter. How our engineering teams deliver We're product-led and agile. Most teams run Scrum with two-week sprints, but we care far more about outcomes than rituals. Engineers are trusted to challenge assumptions, adapt processes, and ship things that matter. Senior engineers here are not heads-down implementers. You'll: Work closely with product, data, and commercial stakeholders Influence technical direction and architectural decisions Balance speed with long-term sustainability Regularly ship meaningful improvements to production Our technology We're pragmatic and cloud-first, running on AWS, with the flexibility to choose the right tool for the job: Exploring: Go, Rust, React, Node.js Core stack: Python, Vue.js & Nuxt, TypeScript Legacy (retiring where we can): Java, PHP, Angular You don't need experience in everything, we value strong fundamentals and good engineering judgement over keyword matching. What you'll be doing Designing, building, and operating production-grade systems that scale Tackling complex technical challenges across backend, infrastructure, data flows, and AI/ML pipelines Writing clean, pragmatic, well-tested code with long-term maintainability in mind Collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders to shape solutions Championing testing, observability, and quality improvements Mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar across the team You'll thrive here if you have Experience in a scale-up or fast-growing product environment Strong backend engineering skills (Go, Java, Python, or similar) A solid understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and performance Experience with CI/CD, modern deployment practices, and cloud infrastructure Comfort working with ambiguity and evolving requirements A bias toward action — shipping value quickly, then iterating A collaborative mindset and the ability to influence beyond your code Bonus: exposure to AI/ML systems, Building AI agents, marketplaces, logistics, pricing, or e-commerce Location and eligibility UK-based, able to commute to Hammersmith. Happy to be onsite at least 3 days per week. Please note we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role at this time. What we offer 💰 Highly competitive salary 🌴 25 days holiday + bank holidays, Christmas Eve off, long-service perks up to 30 days 💪 On-site gym, Vitality membership, enhanced sick pay 📈 Pension – 5% employee / 3% employer 👶 Enhanced maternity pay 🚲 2 minutes from the tube, EV schemes, cycle-to-work, showers & towels ☕ Barista coffee, free breakfast, local discounts 🎉 Weekly drinks, socials, and unforgettable incentive trips 🚀 High ownership, real impact, and the chance to help shape a scaling platform Our company values are: Have fun, get it done Progress over perfection One team thinking big You can find out more about our Company, Culture and Values here: Our Careers Page General FAQ's Our Culture DE&I We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace where every voice is heard, every perspective is valued, and every individual has the opportunity to thrive. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to be part of our mission and contribute to our vibrant culture. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Operations (12 Month Cover)
description: Head of Operations (Cover – 9 to 12 Months) Location: London (Hybrid) Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (9–12 Months) with possibility to extend for the right candidate. Department: Operations Reports to: CEO About us Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit. We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked. Our station network is expanding across continents. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space. We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, Innovate UK. This is Foundational. Position Overview We’re scaling fast- and we’re looking for a sharp, hands-on Head of Operations with a genuine "lets go" attitude to step in for a 9 to 12-month cover and keep our momentum strong. In a high-growth startup environment, you’ll sit at the center of the business—bridging People (HR), Day-to-Day Operations, and Finance to build the scalable structure we need to grow without losing our speed. This isn’t a "keep the seat warm" role. As the company expands, things move quickly and sometimes get messy. You’ll jump straight in to turn chaos into clarity—putting smart structure, repeatable workflows, and financial and people operations in place so our team can execute at full pace, with a smooth handover at both ends of the contract. Key Responsibilities Operations & Scalable Structure Design and implement lightweight, repeatable processes and internal systems that support rapid company scaling without creating red tape. Own day-to-day business operations and tooling to remove bottlenecks and keep cross-functional teams moving fast. Track company-wide KPIs and OKRs, running regular operational check-ins with department leads to flag risks early. Manage vendor relationships, software stack, office/hybrid logistics, and compliance requirements as headcount grows. People & HR Lead the end-to-end people function, scaling our onboarding, offboarding, employee relations, and performance review cycles to match our growth pace. Partner closely with hiring managers to keep recruitment pipelines, contracts, and contractor management running smoothly during a busy hiring period. Champion company culture in a hybrid setup, ensuring high engagement, clear communication, and practical HR policies. Finance & Budgeting Oversee day-to-day financial operations, including monthly close coordination with external accountants, invoicing, accounts payable/receivable, and payroll approvals. Manage departmental budgets, monitor burn rate and cash flow, and work with our accounting team to ensure monthly reporting has everything they need. Build stronger financial controls and identify cost-saving opportunities as operational volume scales. What you’ll bring: Proven operational leadership : Substantial experience in an Operations, or Business Operations leadership role—ideally inside a fast-scaling startup or high-growth company. "Let’s go" energy & builder mindset: You thrive in ambiguity, roll up your sleeves from Day 1, and love turning fast-moving ideas into clean, scalable structures. Multi-disciplinary fluency: Hands-on experience balancing HR/People operations, internal workflows, and financial oversight (budgeting, cash flow, payroll, and vendor management). For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production. Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide. Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments. Immuta has been recognized by Forbes as a top American startup employer, by Inc. Magazine and Built In as one of the best workplaces, and by Fast Company as one of the world’s most innovative companies. Immuta has raised $263 million from investors including NightDragon, Snowflake, Databricks, ServiceNow, Citi Ventures, Dell Technologies Capital, DFJ Growth, IAG, Intel Capital, March Capital, Okta Ventures, StepStone, Ten Eleven Ventures, and Wipro Ventures. We operate as a hybrid workplace with offices in Boston, MA; Columbus, OH; and College Park, MD. ABOUT THE TEAM Immuta’s marketing team sits at the intersection of data, AI, and enterprise growth. We turn a complex, important market problem into clear stories and meaningful connections with the people and organizations Immuta serves. We are building a thoughtful, modern marketing organization—one that values strong fundamentals, smart experimentation, useful data, and the judgment to know when a local insight should change the broader conversation. This team brings Immuta’s global story to life in markets around the world. We work across cultures, customer needs, and market dynamics while staying connected to a shared purpose and a high standard of execution. For marketers who enjoy learning quickly, making sense of complexity, and helping a growing company earn trust in new markets, this is an opportunity to have visible impact with a genuinely global team. ABOUT THE ROLE As Principal, Revenue Marketing (International), you will help shape how Immuta shows up in markets beyond its home base. This individual contributer role offers unusual strategic latitude: you will bring together customer insight, commercial context, and a point of view on where the company can create the most value. You will have the opportunity to influence the way Immuta earns attention, builds credibility, and grows relationships across a diverse set of international audiences. You’ll be part of a team that values clear thinking, thoughtful challenge, and momentum. The work will suit someone who enjoys navigating ambiguity, connecting people around a shared direction, and turning good ideas into progress. You will have visibility with senior partners across the business, the freedom to use your judgment, and the chance to help define how an ambitious data and AI company grows around the world. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Set international marketing strategy, priorities, operating rhythms, and annual plans across priority markets. Translate global go-to-market strategy into integrated regional programs spanning field, partner, digital, account-based, event, content, and campaign marketing. Own international marketing contribution to target-account engagement, meeting creation, sourced pipeline, influenced pipeline, opportunity progression, and revenue growth. Create repeatable AI-enabled workflows and scalable planning processes that improve the speed, quality, relevance, and efficiency of international marketing programs. Partner with regional Sales and Alliances leaders to align on market priorities, account focus, campaign plans, follow-up motions, and performance expectations. Develop partner-led growth through measurable co-marketing programs with strategic technology, cloud, channel, and ecosystem partners. Localize global campaigns, messaging, content, and offers for local audiences while bringing market insight to Product Marketing, Content, Corporate Marketing, and other central teams. Define performance metrics and reporting, analyze results by market and program, and improve investment decisions based on engagement, conversion, pipeline, and return. Manage budgets, agencies, vendors, event investments, and partner resources against clear international priorities, while mentoring peers and raising the quality of work across Marketing. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE International Scope: B2B SaaS or enterprise technology marketing experience across multiple international markets, with ownership of strategy and outcomes. Strategic Ownership: Experience setting international priorities, allocating resources, and delivering sourced or influenced pipeline, opportunities, revenue, account engagement, or market expansion. AI Marketing: Hands-on use of generative AI and AI-powered tools for market intelligence, segmentation, localization, content, personalization, campaign optimization, or analytics; ability to turn experiments into repeatable workflows. Integrated Marketing: Ownership across field, partner, demand, digital, events, content, and campaign marketing, balancing global consistency with local relevance. Executive Influence: Ability to advise senior Sales, Alliances, Marketing, and business leaders; align stakeholders; and communicate recommendations and tradeoffs clearly. Resource Management: Experience influencing international marketing investments and managing agencies, vendors, partners, event investments, or distributed resources. Partner Marketing: Experience building joint go-to-market and measurable co-marketing programs with technology, cloud, channel, or ecosystem partners. Analytics and Operations: Ability to define metrics, interpret funnel and pipeline data, build repeatable planning processes, improve execution, mentor peers, and lead without formal authority. BENEFITS At Immuta, our goal is to help bridge the gap between personal and professional growth, so that our team members can be well and thrive personally and professionally. After all, great professional success stories rarely happen without great personal success stories! Our generous benefits package given to all full time employees includes: 100% employer paid Healthcare (Medical, Dental, Vision) premiums for you and your dependents (including Domestic Partners) Stock Options Paid parental leave (Both Maternity and Paternity) Unlimited Paid time off (U.S. based positions) Learning and Development Resources EEO NOTICE: Immuta provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, marital status, age, disability (including disability due to pregnancy) or genetics, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Senior Software Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.</span></p></div><div> <p><strong>THE WORK:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build and operate the digital-asset infrastructure behind Prisma, our event-driven platform that gives internal teams access to custody providers, wallets, and liquidity partners. You’ll focus on how assets move and are held across the platform: wallet and vault integrations, deposit and withdrawal flows, balance tracking and reconciliation, and portfolio and fund management across accounts. You’ll also contribute to related digital-asset projects such as liquidity management, asset collections, and liquidation services, including controls like maker-checker approvals and segregation of duties.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Integrate with new bank APIs and normalize to the internal system schema. Solving any bespoke integration approaches that will come up.</li> <li>Advance the system forward to an optimal state with clear boundaries and responsibilities</li> <li>Work on our internal trading system (Prisma)</li> <li>Work on a variety of challenges spanning crypto, trading, fintech, and payment solutions.</li> <li>Fully integrate into a large system and spot opportunities for improvements and best practices.</li> <li>Prototype new solutions for complex software problems and implement them for production cloud deployments</li> </ul> </div> <div> <p><strong>WHAT YOU'LL BRING: </strong></p> </div> <div> <ul> <li>Experience building highly scalable and performant enterprise software</li> <li>Working knowledge of Java and its ecosystem (i.e. threading, concurrency ... etc).</li> <li>A positive attitude and a passion for sharing knowledge - the go-to person on the team for small and large questions</li> <li>Interest in fintech, markets, and trading is a must.</li> <li>Knowledge or high interest in our main tools: Java, event-driven architectures (AMQP or similar), gRPC, service meshes, etc.</li> <li>Obsession with finishing projects properly, with good stakeholder management, communications, and documentation.</li> </ul> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>WHO WE ARE:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Do Your Best Work</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Take Control of Your Finances</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Employee giving match</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Mobile phone stipend</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Take Care of Yourself</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">R&R days so you can rest and recharge</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Benefits listed above are for full-time employees. </em></span></p> <hr> <div><em>Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Senior SEM Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. </li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. </li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6"><u data-renderer-mark="true">THE ROLE </u></span></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2301" data-local-id="6d5afd27-5970-45c1-b675-f5df64663cbf"><strong>Senior SEM Manager</strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2320" data-local-id="f6597815-fb6f-48c2-a22a-55ab8b3f15f3">We’re looking for a Senior SEM Manager to run Paid Search execution across our European launch markets, reporting to the Director of SEM. This is an execution role: you will spend most of your time in Google Ads and Google Merchant Center, not in strategy decks. The Director of SEM owns the overall Paid Search and app strategy. You own the day-to-day account – campaign structure, bidding, feed quality, and testing.<br>The ideal candidate is a strong operator who owns a large, feed-driven account and makes fast calls without waiting for perfect data. You care about the details that make a Shopping account perform: feed quality, title and image testing, Quality Score, keyword hygiene. You’re comfortable in a fast-paced environment with real ambiguity and hold your own work to a high standard without needing constant direction.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2320" data-local-id="f6597815-fb6f-48c2-a22a-55ab8b3f15f3"><br>As Senior SEM Manager UK/EU you’ll be central to scaling the UK Paid Search programme and building it out for Germany and France.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2663" data-local-id="e0c03b8d-8a8f-42ae-b3e9-26b5a2308ae6"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Responsibilities</span></strong></p> <ul> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2681" data-local-id="24344a09-732f-4c24-82f1-9b8041341cab">Own day-to-day execution of Paid Search across Google Shopping/PLA,  Google Search, and Apple Search Ads for UK, extending to Germany and France as those markets launch</li> <li data-renderer-start-pos="2681" title: Senior Category Manager, Women's - Wovens UK/EU
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. </li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. </li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p>THE ROLE</p> <p>Senior Category Manager, Women's Woven UK/EU</p> <p>We are seeking a Senior Category Manager, Women's Woven UK/EU to join our growing team. This role is suited to a data-driven product obsessed all-rounder. It supports the execution of merchandising strategy across selected womens’ activewear category, with responsibility for driving regional performance through strong product execution, trading, and customer insight. cross-functionally to bring high-quality products to market.</p> <p>Responsibilities</p> <ul> <li>Own end-to-end product strategy and assortment for women's Woven category in the UK & EU, including assortment execution, launches, and performance tracking</li> <li>Category-expert, sets long-term strategy with support; may build department from the ground up, with oversight</li> <li>Execute regional merchandising strategy in partnership with US Product Merchandising and international regional merchandising peers</li> <li>Contribute to product ideation, helping shape new product opportunities and business cases</li> <li>Work cross-functionally with Product and Regional Merchandising, Planning, Marketing, Technical Design, and Sourcing to deliver successful product launches—balancing inventory, go-to-market execution, and product quality (fit, sizing, and margin)</li> <li>Analyse trading performance (sales, returns, margin) and take ownership of actions to improve results</li> <li>Own pricing and assortment decisions for the region</li> <li>Own product catalogue management and administration, including product setup, data accuracy, and system maintenance</li> <li>Build site merchandising strategy, including PDP improvements roadmap and customer journey optimisations</li> <li>Monitor ratings, reviews, and returns to identify and support product quality improvements</li> <li>Manage regional product samples and merchandising assets</li> <li>Maintain merchandising reports, tools, trackers, and pricing files</li> <li>Take ownership of evaluating regional product compliance requirements and partner with Sourcing and Quality teams to execute</li> </ul> <p>Qualifications required: </p> <ul> <li>Role is based in one of our UK/EU offices (London, Madrid, or Berlin), with 4 days per week in-office requirement</li> <li>8-10 years of retail merchandising or buying experience in womenswear category, (with specific women's woven experience) and demonstrated ownership of category performance</li> <li>E-commerce and/or DTC experience, with exposure to both startup and established (blue-chip) brands preferred</li> <li>Proven track record of progressing within an organization and demonstrating continuous growth in roles and responsibilities</li> <li>Strong product awareness, with a commercial mindset and attention to detail</li> <li>Product obsessed, with experience leveraging data tools and external sources to drive results</li> <li>Critical eye to anticipate customer needs (both the “science” and “art” of retail merchandising)</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, with experience using data to inform trading and merchandising decisions (e.g. sales, margin, return rates)</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in both executional and strategic support roles</li> <li>Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as Planning, Design, Sourcing, or Marketing</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with particular ability to influence through concise written narrative</li> <li>Motivated by working in a fast-paced collaborative environment, where flexibility to stretch into or out of functional comfort zones is crucial for team success</li> <li>Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity and change</li> <li>Bachelor’s Degree, preferred</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-renderer-start-pos="3319"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><u data-renderer-mark="true">WHY QUINCE?</u></strong></p> <p description: ISO 27001 Lead Auditor Calibre | Permanent, full-time | London office, five days a week About Calibre Calibre is building an AI-native certification body. Our platform helps auditors review evidence, document findings and prepare reports, giving them more time to test whether controls work in practice. Auditors retain responsibility for every finding. The role We’re hiring a Lead Auditor to deliver independent ISO/IEC 27001 certification audits, witness new auditors and help shape the tools our audit team uses. Use Calibre’s platform in live audits and show the product team where changes would improve evidence review, reporting or quality checks. Enough hands-on understanding of cloud and security infrastructure to assess evidence such as IAM policies, infrastructure configuration and audit logs. Clear writing and sound audit judgement. You can explain your conclusions to a client’s technical team and defend them in a review. Interest in using AI-assisted tools in audit work and the judgement to verify their output against the underlying evidence. How to apply Create your Auditor Passport and upload your CV. title: Principal Engineer
description: About Motorway Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better. About the team Hi, I'm Mariot, I lead Engineering here at Motorway. We're around 70 engineers across product teams, building the marketplace and all services around that handles hundreds of vehicle transactions every day. We care about delivering value to the business, getting the architecture engineering sound, keeping the production bar high, and being early and deliberate about the technology we adopt. We have been early adopters of GenAI for software engineering, we've built a reputation for that, and we'd like to keep earning it. AI is enabling us to deliver faster at a much higher quality software while easing the maintenance of our existing services. About the role We're looking for a Principal Engineer to set technical direction and evolve engineering practices across Motorway, reporting to the Director of Engineering. This is a broad role: your remit spans multiple product areas and every engineering specialties, and your decisions will shape what we build, what we buy, and what we retire. You'll work with engineering leadership, product, and other functions stakeholders to continuously evolve our overall architecture and practices, and with our senior and staff engineers to turn that direction into working software. description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Role Overview You will design satellite structure and hardware, and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised and under control as the design matures. Working within a small, multidisciplinary team, you will translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing. Key Responsibilities Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, including secondary structures (panels, brackets and component mounts), thermal-control hardware, cable and harness routing, and mechanisms. Primary structure experience is welcome. Work in the satellite's large 3D CAD assembly alongside the wider design team, using top-down design and skeleton models to keep interfaces, configurations and revisions in step as several designers work in the same model. Manage assembly configuration, PLM data (3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX') or similar), bills of materials and engineering change control (ECO/ECR/ECN), so that models, drawings and interfaces stay consistent as changes are released. Run interference and clash checks and maintain the digital mock-up, working with each subsystem owner to allocate space and resolve conflicts. Produce fully dimensioned, manufacturing-ready drawings and interface control documents using GD&T. Support design reviews (PDR and CDR) and qualification, working with structural and thermal engineers on analysis and verification planning. Optimise designs for manufacturability, cost, mass and reliability, working directly with manufacturers and suppliers. Support prototype builds, integration and environmental test campaigns, iterating designs based on results. Collaborate with electrical, software, systems and thermal engineers to integrate mechanical components into the satellite platform. Required Skills & Experience Bachelor's degree in mechanical, aerospace or a related engineering discipline. 3+ years' experience in mechanical design of aerospace, space or other high-reliability hardware, with strong 3D CAD skills (SolidWorks preferred; CATIA, NX or Creo also considered). Practical application of GD&T and experience producing manufacturing-ready drawings. Solid grounding in mechanical design principles, materials and thermal management, with a working understanding of structural mechanics. Demonstrated ability to design, build and test hardware, including troubleshooting and iteration. Clear communicator who is comfortable explaining and defending design decisions, and open to feedback and challenge in a fast-moving team. Preferred Experience Satellite or spacecraft design, ideally detailed design of secondary structures (panel and component mounting, thermal hardware, cable and harness routing). Primary structure experience is a plus. Experience working in large, multi-person CAD assemblies, including top-down design, skeleton or master models, in-context references and configurations. Experience with PLM or PDM systems (for example 3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX'), Windchill, Teamcenter, ENOVIA or SolidWorks PDM), configuration management, revision control and formal change processes (ECO/ECR/ECN). Experience working within formal engineering processes, such as design reviews, documented requirements and standards. Hardware that has launched. Basic FEA familiarity, MGSE or ground-support equipment design, and electromechanical packaging. Why NewOrbit Space? Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology. Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success. title: [2028 graduates] Intern (Antitrust & Competition Economics Practice) - Summer 2027
description: <p><strong>About Charles River Associates</strong></p> <p><strong><a href="http://www.crai.com/">Charles River Associates</a></strong> is a leading global consulting firm that offers economic, financial, and strategic expertise to major law firms, corporations, and governments around the world.  CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.</p> <p>CRA's <strong><a href="https://ecp.crai.com/">European Competition practice</a></strong> specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings before competition authorities and courts: mergers and acquisitions, abuse of dominance allegations, cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, market investigations, litigation and disputes, intellectual property or state aid. We also provide advice to regulatory authorities in similar matters.</p> <p>We have played a key role in many cases that have shaped European competition policy in recent years: from aerospace to software, and manufacturing to transportation. More recently, we have been at the forefront of economic thinking in antitrust investigations and regulation in the tech sector.</p> <p><em>We seek candidates for our London, UK location.</em></p> <p><strong>Position Overview</strong></p> <p>Our <a href="https://www.crai.com/careers/intern-program/">Summer Analyst/Associate Internship program</a> mirrors the analyst experience to give you an understanding of our business and experience project work at Charles River Associates. Throughout the 8-10 week program, Analyst/Associate Interns work alongside senior colleagues to deliver live client consulting projects within the practice area. Along the way, you’ll benefit from professional development and wellness support programs, social events to connect you with peers and a collegial work environment. Successful interns will be offered a full-time position following graduation.</p> <p>Interns work closely with senior consultants, scholars and industry experts on project teams, and will have the opportunity to assist on some of the largest, high-profile and most significant competition cases in Europe. A typical Intern would:</p> <ul> <li>Identify potential issues and conduct analyses that can be used to illustrate economic arguments;</li> <li>Assemble compelling evidence from data and research that support our expert opinions and business recommendations;</li> <li>Program, build models and/or perform regression analyses in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, Python, R), including large data projects requiring use of cloud computing;</li> <li>Assist in the development and presentation of client deliverables, including expert reports and white papers summarising opinions, conclusions, and recommendations using financial, market, industry or client-proprietary data;</li> <li>Communicate complicated economic concepts and arguments to internal teams in an understandable, accessible manner;</li> <li>Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desired Qualifications </strong></p> <ul> <li>Pursuing an undergraduate degree in economics from well-regarded institutions, graduating between December 2027 and August 2028;</li> <li>Strong foundation in microeconomics, industrial economics and/or econometrics;</li> <li>High degree of numeracy and comfort with data manipulation are essential, familiarity with econometric techniques desirable;</li> <li>Curious and analytical thinkers who bring creative approaches to non-standard problems;</li> <li>Effective oral and written communication skills;</li> <li>Eagerness to learn new skills and programming languages;</li> <li>Demonstrated high level of initiative and leadership;</li> <li>Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities;</li> <li>Excellent time management and task prioritisation skills; and</li> <li>Clear and demonstrated interest in consulting through coursework, work experience, activities, or attendance at CRA recruiting events.</li> </ul> <p><strong>To Apply</strong></p> <p>To be considered for this position, please submit the following:</p> <ul> <li><strong>CV/Resume</strong> – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;</li> <li><strong>Covering letter</strong> – please describe your interest in the European Competition practice and how this role matches your goals. </li> </ul> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The internship will take place from Monday 28</span><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-fontsize="12">th</span></span><span data-contrast="auto"> June 2027 – Friday 3</span><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-fontsize="12">rd</span></span><span data-contrast="auto"> September 2027.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><strong>Professional Development </strong></p> <p>CRA’s robust <strong><a href="https://www.crai.com/cra-careers/talent-development/">skills development programs</a></strong> and <a href="https://www.crai.com/benefits/"><strong>wellness programming</strong></a> encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. We provide interns a variety of technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and performance coaching over the summer.</p> <p><strong>Work Location Flexibility</strong></p> <p>CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently ask that individuals spend 3 to 4 days a week on average working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to a client's location), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.</p> <p><strong>Responsible AI Use in Recruiting</strong></p> <p>We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA <a href="https://www.crai.com/cra-careers/ai-recruiting/">on our website</a>.  </p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity</strong></p> <p>Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (Equality Act 2010). As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.</p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-size: 8pt;"><em>The statements included in this job description are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job.  They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.</em></span></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer (Elite Motorsport)
description: <h3><strong>Software Engineer (Motorsport)</strong></h3> <h3><strong>DO YOU WANT TO WORK FOR THE WORLD LEADER IN ELITE SPORTS PERFORMANCE ANALYTICS?</strong></h3> <p>Catapult is a world leader in sports performance technology, serving over 5,000 teams across 40 sports. We improve many of your favorite athletes' performances with our wearable tracking technology, video and data analysis systems, and athlete management products. Our technology offers objective solutions to sport-based challenges and can be found throughout the NFL, NHL, NBA, AFL, NRL, Premier League, Bundesliga, La Liga and many more.</p> <p>In Motorsport, Catapult’s SBG race management and team strategy systems are the technology of choice for elite-level organisers and competitors around the world, including in Formula 1, Formula E, IndyCar, NASCAR, WEC/Le Mans and other worldwide endurance racing. Customers include the FIA, nine Formula 1 teams - including the 8-time World Champion Mercedes AMG Petronas F1 Team - the majority of Formula E teams, the winners of multiple Le Mans 24-hour races over the last 10 years - Audi, Porsche, and Toyota - and teams and organisers in both IndyCar and NASCAR. </p> <p>We have major offices in the UK (London and Leeds), USA (Boston) and Australia (Melbourne) as well as multiple smaller offices around the world.</p> <h3><strong>WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SPORTS AND WANT TO WIN</strong></h3> <p>We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic <strong>Software Engineer (Motorsport)</strong> to grow our Motorsport development team as we expand our RaceWatch products into new series and tackle new challenges.<br><br>Based in the London office (3 days a week), you will be a key player in developing new capabilities in RaceWatch, focussing on one or two racing series, and also contributing to the entire RaceWatch suite.<br><br>We believe that our customers deserve the best platform, and we are on a mission to maximise and enhance their performance through delivering the highest quality experience. As a Software Engineer, you will help us drive our products and processes forward. You will be able to excel in a fast-paced environment with short project timelines from conception to deployment.</p> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO </strong><strong><br></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead the development of our RaceWatch software for one or more motorsport series.</li> <li>Work with product managers and customers to design features and prioritise tasks.</li> <li>Identify ways to add innovative new features to the software.</li> <li>Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code.</li> <li>Contribute to code quality, organization, and best practices throughout the development process.</li> <li>Maintain and enhance software reliability.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU’LL NEED</strong><strong><br></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Degree in computer science, or another scientific or technical subject.</li> <li>A passion for sport.</li> <li>2+ years working in a fast-paced, technical environment, delivering software to customers.</li> <li>A proven track record of building applications in C/C++, or another object-oriented language.</li> <li>Experience developing products, scaling them, and supporting them throughout the entire lifecycle.</li> <li>An aptitude for working with complex data.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical staff, both internally and when speaking to customers.</li> <li>A willingness to go above and beyond for the customer.</li> <li>Ability to help cover live motorsport events at weekends on a rotational basis with the rest of the team.</li> <li>An ability to multi-task and thrive in a dynamic work environment with changing priorities.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>NICE TO HAVE</strong><strong><br></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience developing Windows applications in Visual Studio.</li> <li>Experience developing applications that process video.</li> <li>Experience with ticketing and project management platforms, such as JIRA or Monday.</li> <li>Prior experience working in motorsport is an advantage.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>WHY CATAPULT? </strong></h3> <ul> <li>We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life.</li> <li>We encourage our people to have constructive, open and honest communication; to make Catapult extraordinary; innovate and create smart solutions; establish a collaborative, yet challenging, environment to develop our performance and the performance of our customers.</li> <li>Our workforce spans more than 20 countries so you’ll have the opportunity to work across multiple nationalities and cultures.</li> <li>We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to do things better. There is unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.</li> <li>We care about you. We offer outstanding paid maternity and paternity leave.</li> </ul> <p>Whether you are interested in sports or not, you’ll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams, organisations and competitors on the planet! While we have access to many exciting opportunities, we also realize that we are here to do a very important job for our customers. As a result, we aim to work with purpose and intention. We look for people that fit into our team culture, those who actively contribute and individuals who are excited about what they do. </p> <p>In order to build the future of sports performance, we need the brightest talent. If you think you can contribute to the empowering, enjoyable and exciting Catapult environment, then we invite you to apply.</p> <p>All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.</p> <p><br><br></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: <p><strong>SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER</strong></p> <p>Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to <strong>Unleash the Potential</strong> of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.</p> <p>We work with over 5,800 teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes’ health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  </p> <p>Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. robotics.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE</strong></p> <ul> <li>In 6 months time, you understand the main systems, ship reliable changes, and help improve a meaningful data or description: About us: Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most. Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others. Attribution and performance Own campaigns and marketing attribution frameworks and pipeline source reporting.
